note: Knowledge checks are a reading check only. A pass on them is not verified practical competence.

knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A certificate for the house is refused. Only completed cleaning is reported and the other claims are referred.
The four claims have different responsible parties and are not merged.

practicalCriteria: The learner keeps the four claims separate.
The learner refuses any dry, hygienic or occupancy statement.
Learner completes the procedure record for the mock case and names the stop-work trigger before any practical step.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed mock decision record for the lesson case
Assessor observation of the simulated scenario, with no real site work or hazardous material
stopWorkCriteria: A dry, hygienic or occupancy statement is requested.
A handover would merge cleaning completion with a clearance.
